summary_en: Year-end dividend raised to ¥50/share from ¥30/share for FY3/27, increasing annual total to ¥50/share. Payout ratio 31.1% of revised net income forecast (¥2,200M, up ¥900M from prior guidance due to securities sale gains). Aligns with medium-term plan target of ¥50/share minimum and 30%+ payout ratio.
title_en: Notification regarding upward revision of full-year performance guidance and dividend forecast revision (dividend increase) for fiscal year ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Achilles Corporation announced an upward revision to its full-year performance guidance for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (FY3/27). Net income attributable to parent shareholders was raised from ¥1,300M to ¥2,200M (up ¥900M, or 69.2%), driven by a decision to sell investment securities and record the gain as special income. Sales, operating profit, and recurring profit forecasts remain unchanged at ¥82,500M, ¥2,200M, and ¥2,000M respectively, as the company continues to monitor Middle East geopolitical impacts.

Concurrently, the year-end dividend forecast for FY3/27 was increased to ¥50/share from the prior guidance of ¥30/share. Combined with the ¥0 interim dividend, the full-year dividend is now ¥50/share, up from the prior forecast of ¥30/share. This marks a ¥10/share increase from the prior fiscal year's actual ¥40/share annual dividend. The payout ratio on the revised net income forecast is 31.1%, consistent with the company's medium-term plan (FY25–FY27) target of a ¥50/share minimum dividend and 30%+ payout ratio. The company emphasizes stable, sustainable shareholder returns based on earnings improvement and operational stability.
